# utility.half_max_roots { #clerq.utility.half_max_roots }

```python
utility.half_max_roots(x, y)
```

Return the half-maximum value and the two roots where ``y`` crosses it.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                                                            | Default    |
|--------|------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| x      | np.ndarray | 1-D array of independent variable values (must be monotonically increasing and have enough points for spline fitting). | _required_ |
| y      | np.ndarray | 1-D array of dependent variable values, same length as ``x``.                                                          | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                      |
|--------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | float  | Tuple ``(half_max, r1, r2)`` where ``half_max = max(y) / 2`` and |
|        | float  | ``r1 < r2`` are the two x-values where ``y == half_max``.        |
